figurative_meaning_en: To subdue or quieten someone forcefully
similar_in_english: To put someone in their place
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তেড়ে এসেছিল, কিন্তু আমি তাকে ঠাণ্ডা করে দিলাম।
আলোচনায় উত্তেজিত হয়ে ওঠার পর সবাই ঠাণ্ডা হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He came at me aggressively, but I cooled him down quickly.
After getting heated in the discussion, everyone cooled off.
history: Originated or popularized in the works of Sukumar Ray, a prominent Bengali nonsense verse writer from early 20th-century Kolkata.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of cooling hot tempers, common in Bengali expressive language.
